$note: A Semi style: the look every component reads. tokens = shape, card border, fonts, control sizes; semantic = neutral surface / text / line colours per theme (accent, status and tone colours stay shared). Every style sets the same token keys; semantic keys are optional overrides of tokens/tokens.json. fonts = what the app loads with next/font. Edit, then npm run build:tokens. docs/STYLES.md describes each style.
name: Soft
description: Warm neutrals, borderless cards lifted by a soft shadow, large radii, roomy 40px controls, Plus Jakarta Sans. Calm, friendly screens: consumer apps, storefronts, onboarding.

card-border.note: No visible border: the fill and shadow separate cards (hover / active still colour it)

font-sans.value: var(--font-sans-family, var(--font-jakarta)), "Plus Jakarta Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", sans-serif
